statement: The DualSense output common block has an led_brightness byte (common byte 42) that Linux, SDL and VIIPER all name, but no pinned source defines its values or which LEDs it affects. Linux and SDL leave it zero.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, VIIPER a370903, nondebug 0233835; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 293 (field only); SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 186 (ucLedBrightness, never written); VIIPER dualsense.md 179. Source pending: a July 2026 Linux patch reportedly describes player-indicator brightness levels; not yet pinned or hashed.
